title: OneNote: multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks on Windows
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and Microsoft's supplied notice, including the default, licensing requirement and revised rollout window. The cited Learn controls and qualifications are supported; the preview Graph row needs only to name the request-body property that selects applyOnce.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls: first table row
claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 Apps admin center path is Customization > Policy Management > policy configuration > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks.
claims.quote: Select Customization from the left pane. ... Select Policy Management. ... Create a new policy configuration or edit an existing one. ... From the Choose the scope dropdown list ... In Configure Settings ... Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls: first table row
claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors can apply a desired-state baseline once using the preview applyOnce mode.
claims.quote:
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors

| mode | monitorMode | The monitor mode. The possible values are: `monitorOnly`, `applyOnce`, `unknownFutureValue`. Optional; defaults to `monitorOnly`. |
claims.fix: Keep the endpoint. Replace 'API is preview: applyOnce, resource microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks, value 0 disables' in the front-matter note and rendered table with 'API is preview: set request-body mode to applyOnce and the baseline resourceType to microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks with properties.value set to the string "0" to disable'. Keep the existing tenant-level and group-policy qualifications.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls: first table row
claims.claim: The supported resource is microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks and its value 0 disables the setting.
claims.quote: "resourceType": "microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks" ... | value | Write | String | Allows or prevents creating and viewing Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks through Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Copilot Actions. `0` disables the setting; `1` enables the setting.

claims.claim: The preview TCM route supports these Copilot settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.
claims.quote: TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

claims.claim: The target setting must not be in any group-level policy because applyOnce fails for the resource if it is.
claims.quote: Before using TCM, ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and `applyOnce` fail for that resource.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; controls[1].api; summary; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: MC1405506 says administrators can disable capture with a policy but does not identify a documented UI setting or API specifically for that policy.
claims.quote: Searched: OneNote Windows multimodal capture recording disable policy Copilot Notebooks; "multimodal" "capture" "policy" "OneNote" site:learn.microsoft.com/graph. Read MC1405506, cpcn-admin-configuration and utcm-copilot-resources; no capture-specific switch or API found.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: The checked documentation does not establish that the general Pages and Notebooks creation setting disables Windows multimodal capture.
claims.quote: Searched: "OneNote" "multimodal" "policy" "capture". Read cpcn-admin-configuration and utcm-copilot-resources: creation/integration and Chat/Actions are described, not Windows capture; MC1405506 leaves its policy unnamed.

claims.claim: Learn documents a Cloud Policy setting for creating and viewing Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks.
claims.quote: | **Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation** | Cloud Policy: *Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks* | Enabled |

claims.claim: The Disabled value makes Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation and integration unavailable.
claims.quote: Disabled: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation and integration aren't available to the users.

claims.claim: Disabling creation hides the Notebooks module in the Microsoft Copilot app.
claims.quote: The Pages module is visible in the Microsoft Copilot app, but the Notebooks module is hidden, preventing users from accessing existing Notebooks through the Copilot App.

claims.claim: Disabling creation does not delete existing items.
claims.quote: Existing Copilot Pages and Notebooks aren't deleted. Users can still view and edit existing items if they have permission.
